scope: All lexicographic triple-core removal sets, partitioned by index modulo4; status files I=infeasible in exact encoded query, T=timeout,C=pool cap,F=feasible,N=notrun. Sampled rows have literal pool hashes; full candidate pools are reconstructible from fixed code and universe. Only explicit fixed-core repair families. Primary227 query allows the FULL compatible universe. Secondary226 query explicitly excludes all removed core words; its infeasibility does not by itself exclude every226 code. Timeouts/caps are not proofs.
